title: Dilations of currents in ℝ^P exist and agree with the blow-up η_{a,λ#}
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a). For X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ m) say that X' is a dilation of X if X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all test m-forms ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Then (i) every X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) has a dilation X'; and (ii) if X' is a dilation of X, then X'(ω) = η_{a,λ#}X(ω₁) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) and every ω₁ ∈ 𝒟^m(η(ℝ^P)) (TestFormOn (dilation a λ '' univ) m) whose underlying differential form equals that of ω, where η_{a,λ#}X = blowUp X a λ ∈ 𝒟_m(η(ℝ^P)) is the contract's blow-up (proper affine push-forward of X by η).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∃ X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω')) ∧ ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (ω₁ : TestFormOn (dilation a lam '' (univ : Set (Euclid P))) m), (ω₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) → X' ω = blowUp X a lam hlam.ne' ω₁
